_comment: Version-controlled FlowNav TensorRT build + gate policy. JSON (not YAML) because the repo .gitignore globs *.yaml. Tunables read by engine/inspect_onnx.py and benchmark/bench.py.
_strongly_typed_note: TensorRT >=11 removed weak typing, so FP16 is forced via an FP16 ONNX. The encoder (EfficientNet x2 + a deep DINOv2 ViT-S) is the most precision-sensitive graph; if it drifts in forced FP16 on the strongly-typed path, list it here to build it FP32 (the velocity field + distance head stay FP16). On TRT-10 (the Orin) weak typing handles all three in mixed FP16 and this list is ignored. Start empty; add flownav_encoder if the gate flags encoder drift.
_k_note: K (num_steps) is the flow-matching Euler grid size; the velocity field runs K-1 times and K is the dominant speed lever. The bench sweeps these K and picks the smallest whose trajectory stays within k_quality_waypoint_l2 of the high-K reference AND whose TRT engines pass the fidelity gate. NOTE: the quality-drift metric is measured on SYNTHETIC random inputs, so it is only a coarse proxy -- re-evaluate low-K trajectory quality on REAL images during integration. The bound below is intentionally loose to honor 'relatively low K' (lands on K=4: ~4x speedup, TRT engines still lossless vs torch). Tighten it toward 0.05 for max fidelity-to-10-step, or set num_steps directly in selected.json / FlowNavTRTPolicy(num_steps=...) at runtime (no rebuild).
